entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Iraqi National Intelligence Service is a civilian intelligence agency whose constitutional duty is to collect intelligence, assess threats to national security, and advise the Iraqi government. The INIS is subject to legislative oversight and reports directly to the Prime Minister of Iraq.
